callLimit.body: Phones can't record other apps' calls. Use speakerphone and Room mode instead.
callLimit.consent: Tell the other person you’re recording before you start.
callLimit.ready: Speakerphone on. Room mode is ready.
callLimit.title: Phones can’t record calls

import.doneDesktop: {{app}} sends it to your {{device}} when both are on Wi-Fi.
import.donePhone: Processing on this phone. You’ll get a notification when notes are ready.
import.title: Import to {{app}}

done.body: Tap Record in a meeting, or share a recording to {{app}}. {{app}} never starts recording on its own.
done.title: You’re set

languages.subtitle: {{app}} understands both in one sentence, like “chốt scope cho bản beta”.
languages.title: Which languages do you speak in meetings?

mic.body: It records the room only when you tap Record. Audio stays on this phone unless you send it to your paired computer.
mic.denied: Microphone is off for {{app}}. Turn it on in Settings → {{app}} → Microphone.
mic.title: {{app}} needs the microphone

pair.body: On your computer, open {{app}} → Settings → Sync and scan the code shown there.
pair.syncNote: Voice profiles and notes sync over Wi-Fi.
pair.title: Pair with your computer
pair.wifiNote: Both devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing goes through the internet.

pausedCall.body: {{app}} stopped at {{time}} so the call wasn’t recorded. Everything before it is saved.
pausedCall.title: Paused for a phone call

pocket.hint: Put it face up on the table so {{app}} can hear everyone.
pocket.title: Sound is muffled. Is the phone in a pocket?

target.hintDesktop: Sent to your {{device}} over local Wi-Fi when both are nearby.
target.hintPhone: Runs on this phone after you stop. Uses more battery.

voice.body: Read a 20-second passage so {{app}} labels you as “Me”. The profile stays encrypted on this phone.
voice.consent: I agree to store a voice profile of myself on this phone. I can delete it in Settings.
voice.title: Your voice · optional
